content.about: Angola lies on Africa's southwest coast, with a long Atlantic shoreline, high plateaus and dry deserts in the south. It is rich in oil and diamonds. Its capital, Luanda, is one of Africa's fastest-growing cities. Kizomba and semba music and dance come from Angola.

standout.text: Kalandula Falls is one of Africa's largest waterfalls by volume.

didYouKnow: The giant sable antelope is found only in Angola.
Part of the Namib Desert reaches into southern Angola.
